parameters.content:
## 1. Read the PDF
One item per PDF attachment. A PDF without text (a scan) goes straight to review.

## 2. Extract with AI, then check
OpenAI returns the fields as strict JSON. The checks: required fields, amounts add up, dates, confidence, duplicates.

## 3a. Into the books
Invoices tab, #invoices, Gmail label invoices/processed

## 3b. Needs a person
Unreadable PDFs, failed extractions and failed checks: Review tab, #invoices-review, Gmail label invoices/review

nodes.name: Gmail: new invoice email
nodes.notes: Polls Gmail every minute for emails matching INVOICE_GMAIL_QUERY and downloads their attachments.

nodes.name: Wait 20 s
nodes.notes: Rate limits and server errors are usually gone after a short wait.

nodes.name: Sheets: read Invoices
nodes.notes: Reads the ledger once per run, to spot duplicates.

nodes.name: Gmail: label processed
nodes.notes: Pick the Gmail label "invoices/processed" here after connecting your Gmail credential.

nodes.name: Gmail: label review
nodes.notes: Pick the Gmail label "invoices/review" here after connecting your Gmail credential.
